_comment: Ratchet shield for numeric-named node pages (chaingraph/[0-9]*.html), same rules as page-kernel-digest-baseline.json. `unstamped` shields absence only; `stale` records pages whose declared digest is known wrong, pinned to the exact failing state. Counts only go DOWN: `--update` refuses to ADD or change an entry, and max_unstamped / max_stale are ceilings the strict gate enforces. Written by `--init-numeric` once, pruned by `--update`; never hand-edited.
